section_summary.extract_value: This section reports on a single study (Study X) that recruited N = 1093 university students (568 men, 525 women) from seven universities in Tehran, Iran. Participants were aged 18–50 (M = 25.87, SD = 4.66) and had self-reported BMIs ranging 16.14–36.07 (M = 23.69, SD = 3.48).
section_summary.evidence_source: A total of 1093 university students (568 men and 525 women) were recruited from seven universities in Tehran, Iran. Participant age ranged from 18 to 50 years (M = 25.87, SD = 4.66) and self-reported BMI ranged from 16.14 to 36.07 kg/m2 (M = 23.69, SD = 3.48).
